subject: a tall stack of three thick, fluffy golden buttermilk pancakes with mini chocolate chips melted into the batter, topped with a dollop of whipped cream, a zigzag of dark chocolate fudge sauce and a sprinkle of extra chocolate chips
hero_ko: 반죽 속 미니 초코칩(녹은 반점) + 생크림 + 초코 퍼지 소스 + 여분 초코칩

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The batter itself stays light and golden — this is not a cocoa pancake — but it carries mini chocolate chips, and they show the way they really do after griddling: on the browned top face of each pancake, about ten small dark spots (#3B2418) of different sizes where chips sat just under the surface and melted, each a soft, slightly sunken smudge with blurred edges, some still holding the rounded outline of a chip, others spread into a small irregular smear with a faint gloss; on the pale cream side walls (#F1DDB0), a few flat dark cross-sections of chips sit flush with the crumb, and one or two chips near the edge have melted and run a short dark streak down the wall. The top face otherwise browns in the usual soft blotchy gradient from warm caramel (#B9793F) at the centre to light golden (#D9A76B) at the rim, with a few darker freckles. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: WHIPPED CREAM
toppings.text: One generous dollop of lightly whipped cream (#FFF8EC), spoon-dropped rather than piped, sits slightly off-centre toward the front-left of the top pancake: soft rounded peaks with gentle folds and one curl on top, a matte velvety surface, its lower edge relaxing into a soft skirt against the warm pancake.

toppings.label: FUDGE SAUCE
toppings.text: A warm dark chocolate fudge sauce (#3A2014), thick, glossy and opaque, drizzled from a spoon in three or four loose zigzag lines that cross the cream and the top pancake, the ribbons thick where the spoon slowed and thin where it moved fast, then spilling over the front edge to run down the pale side walls in slow, heavy drips of different lengths — one reaching the bottom pancake and rounding into a soft bead, the others stopping on the middle layer. Where it lies on the cream it sinks slightly into the white; along every ribbon it catches a bright soft highlight.

toppings.label: EXTRA CHIPS AND FINISHING
toppings.text: A small handful of extra mini chocolate chips (#3B2418) — about twelve, a few of them irregular hand-chopped chunks rather than uniform drops — sprinkled over the cream and the sauce, some half-sunk in the cream, a few sliding down onto the browned pancake, one caught in a sauce drip. A barely-there haze of powdered sugar over the far rim of the top pancake, away from the sauce. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.

materials_lighting: Premium food-icon look: slightly simplified, clean forms with believable, appetizing materials — matte tender pancake crumb with a faint velvety sheen only where it browned, soft-matte cream, thick glossy opaque fudge sauce, dry matte chocolate chips with a faint sheen where they melted, and softly glossy melted chip smudges in the crust. Soft studio softbox key light from the upper left with gentle warm ambient fill, a subtle rim of light along the top edges of the stack, and a faint, soft contact shadow directly beneath the stack only. Appetizing food-photography color grading: warm, fresh, clean whites, saturated but natural colours, no colour cast on the background. Shot as if with an 85 mm lens at a comfortable distance, everything in crisp focus.
camera: Three-quarter top-front view, the dessert centered with generous margin on all sides.
background: Background: seamless solid pale sage (#DFEAE0), flat and even.
mood: an indulgent diner-style chocolate-chip breakfast, sauce still running, that makes you want to pick up a fork.

notes_ko: v5(2026-09-02): 리서치(med) — 초코칩은 반죽 속에 섞여 굽는 동안 부분적으로 녹아 반점처럼 박히는 것이 정체성(반죽은 밝은 황금색 유지, 코코아형과 구분). v2~v4의 "상감 보석"은 칩이 안 녹은 각진 조각이라서 — "melted into soft sunken smudges with blurred edges"로 실제 모습 서술. 위에는 생크림 + 퍼지 소스 지그재그 + 여분 칩(서양 레시피 표준).
